verdict.rationale: Gumloop lets users connect to 'any' MCP server, which implicitly includes community-built MCP servers/tools not made by Gumloop, and also supports proxied/hosted MCPs for external servers. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated marketplace, gallery, or install mechanism for community-contributed nodes/components within Gumloop's own node system—MCP connection is the only vector, and it's user-configured rather than a curated community-ecosystem listing. Missing for 10: a community node/integration marketplace, evidence of third-party-authored nodes being installable/discoverable inside Gumloop, and any listing of community-contributed connectors beyond generic MCP server connectivity.
